posts.title: Using Dotfiles to Manage Agentic Workflow Artefacts
posts.description: I love agentic programming. Over the past two years I’ve built several CLIs and webapps to smooth my workflow. One problem persisted. Design a command for Project A, and you want it in Project B. Build a sub-agent fluent in Golang, and it sits useless in your JavaScript work. You need selectivity - certain artefacts for certain projects, no duplication. My instinct: build a centralised repository
